desc: Push beyond ordinary beams with 200,000 candela of long-range power, throwing focused light over 1,200 meters. Whether scanning a search area or cutting through foggy waters, the USB-C rechargeable powerhouse delivers pinpoint visibility with 2,000 lumens. The NSR-7000 carries an integrated stand built for turning the spotlight into a hands-free scene light. The rugged IP-X8 waterproofing and 2-meter drop protection stand up to tough conditions and will float when dropped into water. The rear rotary switch shifts between high, medium, and low modes, so you stay geared up without swapping lights.
